# deps: reached limits

Unblock Dependabot, which had stopped opening pull requests:

```
Errored with the message "Dependabot cannot open any more pull requests"
The open pull request limit has been exceeded. The current limit is: 5.
```

With daily checks ([#411](DOT-405.md)) and a fast-moving tool set (esbuild, yq, gojq, x/tools), five unmerged PRs accumulated within days whenever the author was away, and every further update stalled.
